content.comment_body: Hello, After weeks of trying to solve this, I decided to ask here for help. My [product_name] is connected to AWS cloud and is sending data—specifically, two analog and three digital signals. The digital values are straightforward (0 or 1), visible in the device shadow, but the analog data is confusing. For example, I receive something like "00000080800003" and I have tried many conversion methods, but haven't figured out how to get the actual value. This data is supposed to represent values from 0 to 2 BARS and anything in between. Reviewing the manual hasn't clarified things. I'm using Lambda to read from the device shadow, but all I get is a hexadecimal number; even after converting to decimal, it remains unclear. Any advice? Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: User faces difficulties interpreting analog data from [product_name] transmitted to AWS cloud, as the values appear in an unintuitive hexadecimal format within the device shadow. While digital outputs are easily understood, analog readings remain unclear. Manuals and conventional conversion methods have not clarified the data format, hindering data processing and integration.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects analog values to be presented in a clear, understandable format, similar to digital data, with thorough documentation or guidance for conversion.
